title: Letters and Songbook
author: Coral Nystrom
blurb: Petra Okonkwo, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
